The '''''Lady Zay''''' is a galleon in possession of pirates from [[Pirates' Cove]] and is owned by [[Captain Bentley]]. To reach her, players must speak to [[Lokar Searunner]] on [[Rellekka]]'s western-most dock, who will row them to the docked Lady Zay. From there, players can reach [[Lunar Isle]].

Barrels of [[Tar barrel|swamp tar]], [[Barrel (cooking apples)|cooking apples]], and [[Barrel (cooking apples)#Rotten|rotten apples]] can be found around the ship. The barrels have a 1 in 3 chance of emptying when a player loots them and refill after 24 seconds when they empty.{{CiteTwitter|author=Mod Ash|url=https://twitter.com/JagexAsh/status/1053389315626229762|date=19 October 2018|archiveurl=https://reldo.runescape.wiki/i/98559|archivedate=30 May 2020|quote=1/3. Same for the apples.}}

==History==
The Lady Zay is one of the largest ships on [[Gielinor]], spanning three floors and measuring the length of the cove. There are many rooms within the ship, including the captain's room, two lookout areas, multiple cabins, a kitchen, storeroom, artillery deck, and a small prison containing a [[Suqah]]. The ship is armed with nearly a dozen large cannons.

Captain Bentley reveals during [[Lunar Diplomacy]] that the Lady Zay was originally a warship, built in and stolen from the [[Shipyard (Karamja)|Karamja shipyards]].{{CiteNPC|npc=Captain Bentley|loc=Lunar Diplomacy|quote=It was a steal from the Karamjan shipyards. And when I say it was a steal, I mean to say that myself and some of the lads broke in and stole it one night.}} He mentions that they had to remodel the ship's interior because she was built for a crew that was small in stature.{{CiteNPC|npc=Captain Bentley|loc=Lunar Diplomacy|quote=I don't know who they were building these warships for, but whoever it was seemed to be a little on the short side. We had to do a little remodelling of the doors and rooms so that we didn't have to crouch around everywhere, but I've finally got her just how I want her, and we have enough cannons down below decks to bombard a small town I'd wager!}} This is a direct reference to the events of [[Monkey Madness I]], during which [[Glough]] secretly raises an army of ships for gnomekind to take over Gielinor.
